message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **federal long‑weekends** in Canada for the year 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, keep in mind that many provinces add their own holidays—e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Family Day in Alberta, etc.—which can also create long‑weekends.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** (Sunday) | New Year’s Day | Sun | **Sat 31 Dec – Mon 2 Jan** | Observed on Mon 2 Jan |
| **Feb 20** (Monday) | Family Day (Ontario, AB, SK, NB, NL, PE) | Mon | **Sat 18 – Mon 20** | Federal holiday in several provinces |
| **Apr 7** (Friday) | Good Friday | Fri | **Fri 7 – Sun 9** | Federal holiday |
| **May 22** (Monday) | Victoria Day | Mon | **Sat 20 – Mon 22** | Federal holiday |
| **Jul 1** (Saturday) | Canada Day | Sat | **Sat 1 – Mon 3** | Observed on Mon 3 |
| **Sep 4** (Monday) | Labour Day | Mon | **Sat 2 – Mon 4** | Federal holiday |
| **Oct 9** (Monday) | Thanksgiving | Mon | **Sat 7 – Mon 9** | Federal holiday |
| **Nov 11** (Monday) | Remembrance Day | Mon | **Sat 9 – Mon 11** | Federal holiday |
| **Dec 25** (Monday) | Christmas Day | Mon | **Sat 23 – Mon 25** | Federal holiday |

### Quick Takeaway
- **9 federal long‑weekends** in 2023.
- The only federal holiday that falls on a weekday but does **not** create a long‑weekend is **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, Tuesday).
- Provincial holidays can add more long‑weekends; check your province’s holiday calendar for the full list.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app, and let me know if you’d like provincial variations or a different format!
